title: Hangman
goal: Guess the hidden word in fewer than 6 attempts
rule1: At the beginning, the letters of the word will be represented by the '_' character
rule2: You can only enter one letter or one word at a time (uppercase or lowercase)
rule3: Correct letters will be revealed in their corresponding positions
rule4: Each incorrect letter or word will cost you one life
rule5: Revealing all the letters means you win
rule6: You can surrender at any time by clicking on the white flag.
rule7: Running out of lives means you lose.
rule8: That's it! You're ready to play. Good luck!
